e.M: Measured or tried in a browser by the spike runner (S1 to S15) or by hand
e.S: Verified in source or registry (read by research agents, not re-checked)

dimensions.label: Licence
dimensions.help: Compatible with an Apache-2.0 project shipping a browser bundle, or flagged for legal review

dimensions.label: Browser-only
dimensions.help: Runs in the browser from static files, no per-user server

dimensions.label: React
dimensions.help: React 18/19 component, or an API a thin wrapper can drive with clean mount/unmount

dimensions.label: Maintained
dimensions.help: Recent release or commit, not archived, maintainer answers

dimensions.label: Tip events
dimensions.help: Click/hover on tips with a React callback

dimensions.label: Node events
dimensions.help: Click/hover on internal nodes and branches, with the descendant tips

dimensions.label: Tip links
dimensions.help: Tip label as a real, focusable link

dimensions.label: Clade colour
dimensions.help: Colour a clade from code and clear it again

dimensions.label: Custom columns
dimensions.help: Aligned per-tip content (counts, alignments, traits), ideally React-rendered

dimensions.label: Styling hooks
dimensions.help: Tokens, per-node style callbacks, dark mode

dimensions.label: Overview
dimensions.help: Whole-tree view, minimap, summaries when zoomed out

dimensions.label: Scale
dimensions.help: How many tips it handles, measured not claimed

dimensions.label: Tree ops
dimensions.help: Reroot, collapse, prune, subtree in the library

candidates.title: tbrowse
candidates.summary: React component for a tree with aligned data zones. Closest to the table-like layout we like.
candidates.verdict: Best fit for the table-like aligned-zones layout; measured: 1k tips fine, 10k first render 4.2 s and 553 ms CPU per step, 100k takes 154 s to mount, no overview, no radial. Stack overflow on caterpillars of 5k tips.

node.t: S3 partial: node events carry no tip set (adapter-derived)

clade.t: S4 pass via a DOM patch

cols.t: S7, S8 pass: ZoneDefinition zones aligned to 0 px; built-in MSA zone takes FASTA

style.t: S9 pass: GBIF tokens map onto --tbrowse-* variables

bl.t: S11 pass after the adapter rescales: the library has a 0.01 absolute branch-length floor

overview.t: No whole-tree zoom-out (confirmed by hand and by S10 n/a)

scale.t: 1k fine; 10k first render 4.2 s, 553 ms CPU per step; 100k mounts in 154 s; cost grows with rows squared

parse.t: Flat node table input; caterpillars of 5k tips overflow the stack

candidates.title: react-bio-viz
candidates.summary: React components for biological views, including PhyloTree and a canvas alignment viewer.
candidates.verdict: Cleanest React API, and the only one whose node click delivers the tip set itself. Measured: fine at 1k, unusable at 10k (6.4 s first render), 100k mounts in 65 s. Recursive code overflows on large caterpillars and throws on the 91k to 190k real trees.

g4.t: Releases 2026-10-07/08 after a 2024 gap; one maintainer

tip.t: S2 pass; hover only via a DOM workaround

node.t: S3 pass: the library delivers the tip set (source: library), the only candidate that does

clade.t: S4 pass via nodeStyles and branchStyles

cols.t: S7, S8 pass, but drawn on our own canvas outside the library; columns cannot live in leafTextComponent

style.t: S9 pass; support shading defaults on and wrecks named labels

layout.t: S12 pass, but radial needed a virtual canvas; no unrooted

overview.t: S10 n/a: plain wheel pans, nothing zooms to overview

scale.t: 1k fine; 10k first render 6.4 s, click to paint 1.3 s; 100k mounts in 65 s; throws RangeError on the 91k to 190k real trees

parse.t: Newick only; recursive, caterpillars of 3k+ tips overflow the stack

ops.t: Reroot, midpoint, collapse, ladderize work in the demo; node ids change meaning after reroot

candidates.title: phylotree.js
candidates.summary: d3-based phylogenetics library with rendering, selection and tree operations.
candidates.verdict: Most hookable (stylers, events) but needs our own React wrapper. Measured: good to about 700 tips, unusable at 10k (3 fps, 430 ms click), 100k first render 14 s. Several library bugs (scale bar, reroot, missing lengths).

g1.t: MIT per LICENSE; no license field in package.json

g3.t: Own wrapper needed (1 to 2 weeks to 1k tips); S13 pass

node.t: S3 partial: tip sets from node.leaves() (adapter-derived)

cols.t: S7, S8 pass with our own SVG in node-styler; uniform zoom pushes columns out of view

layout.t: Rectangular, radial (S12 pass), unrooted and mirrored

bl.t: S11 pass; library scale bar about 20% off; a missing length flattens all lengths to 1

overview.t: S10 timeout at 10k, partial at 1k; no overview

scale.t: Pass to about 700 tips; 10k: 3 fps, 190 to 211 ms CPU per step, 410 to 430 ms click; 100k first render 14 s

parse.t: Nexus TRANSLATE not applied; first tree only; [..] comments stay in tip names

ops.t: Reroot, ladderize, collapse; reroot drops all listeners

candidates.title: Phylocanvas.gl
candidates.summary: WebGL tree renderer from the Centre for Genomic Pathogen Surveillance; powers Microreact.
candidates.verdict: WebGL renderer with no callbacks: events, node clicks, links and columns are our own code (about 1,560 lines). Scale could not be judged without a GPU: software GL times out on 19 of 20 trees, while JS cost looks fine.

g3.t: Own wrapper, about 1,560 lines and eight workarounds; S13 pass

g4.t: Published 2026-07; upstream README says feature complete, no support; deck.gl 8.9.x crashes it (pin 8.8.27)

node.t: S3 partial: our own hit-test, adapter-derived tip sets

clade.t: S4 pass: styles every tip under the clade

link.t: S6 pass via a DOM overlay

cols.t: S7, S8 pass with our own deck.gl layers

style.t: S9 pass through props; WebGL, no CSS

bl.t: S11 pass: cladogram toggle and scale bar

overview.t: S10 partial at 1k and 10k, timeout at 100k (software GL)

scale.t: Not resolved without a GPU: 19 of 20 trees time out on frame share under software GL; JS cost fine (3.2 s constructor, 590 MB heap at 190k); the 100K+ claim is neither confirmed nor refuted

parse.t: Newick only; trimQuotes alters real labels; non-ASCII glyphs dropped

candidates.title: Archaeopteryx.js
candidates.summary: Full phylogenetic tree viewer (port of the Java tool) with heat map, alignment and domain tracks.
candidates.verdict: Richest built-in tracks and formats, but a whole app: no click callback, one viewer per page (S13 fails), unusable from about 900 tips on the new metric, stack overflow on a 10k caterpillar.

g1.t: LGPL-3.0 plus LGPL-2.1+ phyloxml dependency; separate replaceable file needed

g3.t: Imperative launch from an effect; one viewer per page: S13 fails (the second instance blanks the first)

g4.t: One maintainer; 22 releases in 33 days; 118 config keys removed in 3.0

tip.t: S2 pass, but through DOM hit tests: no click callback (adapter-derived)

node.t: S3 partial: derived from DOM hits plus our tree model

cols.t: S7 partial, S8 pass: built-in heat map and alignment tracks; heat-map-only, needs a mirror column for bars

style.t: S9 pass; some config keys not honoured

scale.t: Unusable from 888 tips on the new metric (142 ms CPU per step); 10k 1.5 to 2.4 s per step; larger trees skipped; the 50k at 60 fps claim is not reproduced

parse.t: Newick, NHX, Nexus, phyloXML, Auspice JSON, BEAST annotations; 10k-deep caterpillar overflows the stack

ops.t: Reroot via its menu breaks id mapping

candidates.title: Custom baseline (ours)
candidates.summary: Our own typed-array tree model with a Canvas2D renderer and a React layer, built during this spike as a baseline.
candidates.verdict: Built as a prototype. 20 of 20 test trees pass up to 190k tips with no slow frames (8 to 17 ms CPU per step); clade, columns, overview, links and keyboard pass. Author's estimate to production: 12 to 18 engineer-weeks. Ladderised trees still cost a full tree walk per frame.

node.t: S3 partial only by rule: tip sets are derived from the preorder range (adapter-derived), correct against ground truth, O(1)

link.t: S6 pass: real a[href] overlay for visible rows

cols.t: S7, S8 pass: bar, text and alignment columns on canvas, aligned to the pixel

style.t: S9 pass: all colours and fonts from the GBIF tokens, dark theme

layout.t: Rectangular and radial (S12 pass); no unrooted

bl.t: S11 pass; scale bar and time axis self-reported

overview.t: S10 pass: overview strip, clade summaries when zoomed out

scale.t: 20 of 20 trees to 190k: 0% slow frames; 1M tips 1.4 to 3 ms per frame in the author's JS timing (no GPU)

parse.t: Uses our iterative Newick parser; no phyloXML or Nexus annotations in the viewer

ops.t: No reroot, search or user collapse yet

g3.t: Controlled React component, clean unmount, two instances (S13 pass)

candidates.title: Taxonium
candidates.summary: WebGL viewer for trees with millions of nodes, shipped as a whole app inside a React component.
candidates.verdict: Strong renderer, wrong packaging: GPL-3.0, React 19 only, singleton, only onNodeSelect. Not spiked.

g1.t: GPL-3.0; no license field in the component package

g4.t: Last commit 2026-10-07; npm 2026-02-04; about 85% of commits by one person

clade.t: Colour by metadata field or search state

bl.t: x axis can switch between distance and time

scale.t: Millions of nodes claimed; browser unreliable above about 6M tips

parse.t: Newick, Nexus via regex; no phyloXML

candidates.title: Reactree
candidates.summary: React component for Newick trees with an optional alignment panel.
candidates.verdict: Three props, no callbacks or custom content; rebuilds the whole SVG on any change; captures Ctrl/Cmd+F. Rejected.

g3.t: Component, but no callbacks or refs

node.t: Click collapses a clade internally; no event

style.t: CSS tokens and data-theme dark mode

scale.t: 26 px per leaf, whole SVG rebuilt on change

ops.t: Reroot and collapse in the UI

candidates.title: Heat-tree
candidates.license: MIT (R package); none in JS repo
candidates.summary: 2026 embeddable tree widget with JS, R and Python packages.
candidates.verdict: No click, hover or select callbacks and no highlight API; good Nexus parsing (TRANSLATE, multi-tree). Rejected as a component.

g1.t: MIT on the R package; no LICENSE file in the JS repo

parse.t: Nexus with TRANSLATE and multiple trees

candidates.title: OneZoom
candidates.summary: Tree of life explorer with about 2.2 million species; the strongest scale evidence in this list.
candidates.verdict: Architecture to learn from (compact topology, lazy nodes, adaptive level of detail), not a component: no npm package, global singleton, own data format, restrictive licence.

scale.t: 2.2M species live; 2.2M nodes in a 4.5 MB data file
